newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale sees 70 pct take up.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale sees 70 pct take up.

text.p: The 14th sale of the season saw the Committee of London Wool Brokers, acting on behalf of the British Wool Marketing Board, offer a total of approximately 2,025,370 kilos of British wool.
Interest was limited in an end of season offering with about 70 percent of the catalogue sold.
Picks and Supers were fully five percent dearer with Halfbreds par to 2.5 percent cheaper and crosses 2.56 per cent cheaper.
Radnors were up to 2.5 per cent cheaper except Grey Radnors which were five percent dearer.
All Welsh were five percent cheaper and Swaledale were also 2.5 percent cheaper where sold.
